title: Thai-Style Wholesome Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry made with wholesome noodles, springy vegetables, and a hint of Thai curry.
instructions: 1. Cook the wholesome noodles according to the package instructions.
2. In a large skillet or wok, heat the nuka sauce over medium-high heat.
3. Add the springy vegetables and cook until they start to soften.
4. Add the curry powder and stir-fry for 1 minute.
5. Add the cooked noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
6. Add the pickle juice and season with salt and pepper to taste.
